description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractRestParser used for parsing REST API responses in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for extracting payloads, headers, and status codes from responses, and serves as a base class for specific REST response parsers.

classes.name: AbstractRestParser
classes.description: An abstract class for parsing REST API responses in the AWS SDK, providing common methods for extracting payloads, headers, and response status.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Abstract method to parse the payload from the response, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the response parsing process when the parser is invoked as a callable, coordinating payload extraction and header/status processing.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts payload data from the response response into the result array, handling streaming data and structured data.

methods.name: extractHeader
methods.description: Extracts a specific header from the response based on the provided shape information.

methods.name: extractHeaders
methods.description: Extracts multiple headers with an optional prefix into the result.

methods.name: extractStatus
methods.description: Extracts the response's status code into the result array.
